records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2023, revenue increased $11 million or 1.9% and $177 million or 11.1%, respectively, and net income attributable to NOW Inc. decreased $5 million and increased $4 million, respectively, when compared to the corresponding periods of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We offer higher value solutions in key product lines in the U.S. which broaden and deepen our customer relationships and related product line value.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average price per short ton of Hot-Rolled Coil declined 22.0% (from $1,065.28 per short ton to $830.97 per short ton) in the third quarter of 2023 compared to the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average price per barrel of West Texas Intermediate Crude increased 11.6% (from $73.76 per barrel to $82.30 per barrel), and natural gas prices increased 19.9% (from $2.16 per MMBtu to $2.59 per MMBtu) in the third quarter of 2023 compared to the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2023, the Company generated an operating profit of $37 million and $108 million, respectively, compared to an operating profit of $44 million and $96 million, respectively, for the corresponding periods of 2022.
